metadata.question: Did the NVDI within a 10 mile raidus over coordinates (39.493523, -122.107805) decrease between September 4, 2021 and Septebmer 16, 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- AOI: 10-mile buffer around point (lat=39.493523, lon=-122.107805).
- Primary: Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR). Fallback: Landsat 8/9 C2 L2 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2 and LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2).
- Date windows per target date (2021-09-04, 2022-09-16): try ±14 days; if empty, ±30 days; if still empty, switch to Landsat ±30 then ±60 days.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask clouds/cirrus for S2 using QA60 bits 10/11. For Landsat L2, mask QA_PIXEL bits (cloud, cirrus, shadow, snow).
- Compute NDVI per image and then take median composite.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If no images in all attempts for a date: C1.
- If images exist but valid pixels after masking are zero: C2.
- If mean NDVI is null/NaN or outside [-1, 1]: C3.
- Otherwise compare means: if 2022 < 2021 => A (Yes), else B (No).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function getInfo(eeObject) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      eeObject.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const lat = 39.493523;
  const lon = -122.107805;
  const miles10m = 16093.44; // meters
  const geom = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(miles10m);

  const date1 = '2021-09-04';
  const date2 = '2022-09-16';

  // 2. Masking & NDVI prep functions
  function prepS2(image) {
    const qa = image.select('QA60');
    const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
    const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
    const ndvi = image.updateMask(mask).normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI');
    return ndvi.copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']);
  }
  function prepL89(image) {
    const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
    const cloudShadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
    const snow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0);
    const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0);
    const mask = cloud.or(cloudShadow).or(snow).or(cirrus).not();
    // Scale SR to reflectance and compute NDVI
    const scaled = image.updateMask(mask)
      .select(['SR_B4', 'SR_B5'], ['RED', 'NIR'])
      .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
    const ndvi = scaled.normalizedDifference(['NIR', 'RED']).rename('NDVI');
    return ndvi.copyProperties(image, ['system:time_start']);
  }

  async function tryBuild(dateStr, days, sensor) {
    const start = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(-days, 'day');
    const end = ee.Date(dateStr).advance(days, 'day').advance(1, 'day'); // include end day
    if (sensor === 'S2') {
      const base = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
      const size = await getInfo(base.size());
      if (size === 0) return { ok: false, images: 0, sensor, days };
      const ndviCol = base.map(prepS2).select('NDVI');
      const composite = ndviCol.median().rename('NDVI');
      return { ok: true, composite, images: size, sensor, days };
    } else {
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom);
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(geom);
      const base = l8.merge(l9);
      const size = await getInfo(base.size());
      if (size === 0) return { ok: false, images: 0, sensor, days };
      const ndviCol = base.map(prepL89).select('NDVI');
      const composite = ndviCol.median().rename('NDVI');
      return { ok: true, composite, images: size, sensor, days };
    }
  }

  async function getStatsForDate(dateStr) {
    const attempts = [
      { sensor: 'S2', days: 14 },
      { sensor: 'S2', days: 30 },
      { sensor: 'L89', days: 30 },
      { sensor: 'L89', days: 60 },
    ];
    let anyImages = false;
    for (const att of attempts) {
      let result;
      try {
        result = await tryBuild(dateStr, att.days, att.sensor);
      } catch (e) {
        throw e;
      }
      if (!result.ok) {
        if (result.images > 0) anyImages = true;
        continue;
      }
      anyImages = true;
      // Compute stats at coarse scale (to avoid timeout)
      const mean = ee.Image(result.composite).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('NDVI');
      const validCount = ee.Image(result.composite).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('NDVI');
      const totalCount = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('one');

      const [meanVal, vCount, tCount] = await Promise.all([getInfo(mean), getInfo(validCount), getInfo(totalCount)]);
      const cloudPct = (tCount && tCount > 0) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 100 * (1 - (vCount / tCount)))) : null;

      if (!vCount || vCount === 0) {
        // No valid pixels after masking, try next attempt
        continue;
      }
      return {
        status: 'OK',
        mean: meanVal,
        vCount: vCount,
        tCount: tCount,
        cloudPct: cloudPct,
        sensor: result.sensor,
        days: result.days,
        images: result.images,
      };
    }
    if (!anyImages) {
      return { status: 'C1' };
    } else {
      return { status: 'C2' };
    }
  }

  try {
    console.log(`AOI center: (39.493523, -122.107805), radius=10 mi`);
    const s1 = await getStatsForDate(date1);
    if (s1.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`Date ${date1}: status=${s1.status}`);
      console.log(s1.status);
      return;
    }
    const s2 = await getStatsForDate(date2);
    if (s2.status !== 'OK') {
      console.log(`Date ${date2}: status=${s2.status}`);
      console.log(s2.status);
      return;
    }

    // Validate NDVI range and values
    const invalid1 = (s1.mean === null || isNaN(s1.mean) || s1.mean < -1 || s1.mean > 1);
    const invalid2 = (s2.mean === null || isNaN(s2.mean) || s2.mean < -1 || s2.mean > 1);
    if (invalid1 || invalid2) {
      console.log(`Validation: invalid NDVI (range or null).`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const line1 = `Date ${date1}: sensor=${s1.sensor}, imgs=${s1.images}, window=±${s1.days}d, validPix=${s1.vCount}/${s1.tCount}, cloud=${s1.cloudPct !== null ? s1.cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%, NDVI=${s1.mean.toFixed(3)}`;
    const line2 = `Date ${date2}: sensor=${s2.sensor}, imgs=${s2.images}, window=±${s2.days}d, validPix=${s2.vCount}/${s2.tCount}, cloud=${s2.cloudPct !== null ? s2.cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}%, NDVI=${s2.mean.toFixed(3)}`;
    console.log(line1);
    console.log(line2);

    const diff = s2.mean - s1.mean;
    console.log(`Difference (2022 - 2021) NDVI = ${diff.toFixed(3)}`);

    const answer = diff < 0 ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0, 200)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
